questions.q: What is the first step in starting a Bullet Journal?
questions.why: The book advises to organize thoughts before writing.

questions.q: Which symbol marks a completed task in the journal?
questions.why: Completed tasks are crossed with an "x".
Urgency is shown by adding an asterisk.

questions.q: What does a right‑facing arrow do to a task?
questions.why: A right‑facing arrow reschedules the task for the month.

questions.q: During monthly migration, what happens to tasks that are no longer vital?
a: They are moved to future log
questions.why: Unnecessary tasks are crossed off during migration.
